title: 12 Best Seafood Restaurants in Kota Kinabalu (2026)

venues.name: Welcome Seafood Restaurant
venues.address: Lot G 18, Kompleks Asia City Phase 2A, 88300 KK
venues.verdict: The most famous seafood restaurant in KK — a bustling institution with live tanks and an enormous menu.
venues.whatToOrder: Butter prawns, kam heong crab, steamed fish with soy sauce.

venues.name: Fatt Kee Seafood Restaurant
venues.address: Lorong Hilltop, Taman Far East, 88300 KK
venues.verdict: A 20-year local favorite — the legendary fish noodle soup alone is worth the trip.
venues.whatToOrder: Fish noodle soup (signature), Tom Yam seafood soup, stir-fried clams.

venues.name: KK Garden Seafood Gaya Restaurant
venues.verdict: Highest-rated seafood in downtown KK — spacious outdoor seating, live tanks, fresh catches.
venues.whatToOrder: Salted egg squid, sweet and sour crab, fresh oysters.

venues.name: Kampung Nelayan Floating Restaurant
venues.verdict: One-of-a-kind floating restaurant — dine lakeside with nightly cultural performances.
venues.whatToOrder: BBQ steamboat buffet, grilled stingray, seafood platter.

venues.name: Jumbo Palace Seafood Restaurant
venues.address: Lot G1, Kompleks Asia City, 88200 KK
venues.verdict: KK’s late-night seafood king — Sichuan heat meets Borneo-fresh catches until 3 AM.
venues.whatToOrder: Sichuan mala crab, spicy prawns, chili lobster.

venues.name: Fish Market Restaurant
venues.address: A-G-2, Block A, Sutera Avenue, 88000 KK
venues.verdict: Premium KK seafood — live tanks, refined setting, and the famous sauna steamboat.
venues.whatToOrder: Sauna steamboat (signature), fresh lobster, seafood platter.

venues.name: Suang Tain Seafood Restaurant
venues.address: No. 16, Block D, Sedco Complex, Kampung Air, 88000 KK
venues.verdict: Always packed, always fast — no-frills seafood beloved by locals for fresh crab.
venues.whatToOrder: Fresh crab (any style), prawns, lobster, oysters.

venues.name: Gayang Seafood Restaurant
venues.verdict: Halal-certified waterfront gem — pick live seafood from display tanks at affordable prices.
venues.whatToOrder: Chili crab, grilled fish, fresh clams. Pick from tanks.

venues.name: Sembulan Lobster Restaurant
venues.address: Com Development, Jalan Mat Salleh, 88100 KK
venues.verdict: KK’s lobster specialist — great for steamboat too.

venues.name: New Gaya Seafood Restaurant
venues.address: L01-02, Plaza Shell, 29 Jln Tunku Abdul Rahman, 88000 KK
venues.verdict: Hidden gem in Plaza Shell — excellent butter prawns and stir-fried clams.
venues.whatToOrder: Butter prawns (signature), stir-fried clams, steamed fish.

venues.name: Imperial Seafood Restaurant
venues.verdict: Live aquarium tanks where you handpick dinner. DIY hotpot adds to the fun.
venues.whatToOrder: Pick live seafood — lobster, prawns, grouper. Hotpot for groups.

venues.name: New Luyang Restaurant
venues.address: Shop 1, Jalan Kolam, Luyang Phase 1, 88300 KK
venues.verdict: Long-standing local favorite away from tourists — classic Chinese seafood done right.
venues.whatToOrder: Steamed fish, chili crab, salted egg prawns.
